ceu: ✦ The square between the Moon and Venus at {H:1828301508000}

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your image and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your career and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between relationships and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between routine and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between romance and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between family and your image. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between money and friendships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.
